briefing: Markets pulled back today with NASDAQ down 1.1% and the S&P 500 down 0.5%, putting conditions firmly in risk-off territory. No new candidates were screened, so we're holding all 7 existing positions and letting stop-loss/profit-target rules handle any automatic exits rather than making discretionary moves.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when investors broadly sell riskier assets like growth stocks and move toward safer holdings, often causing indices like NASDAQ to fall more than broader benchmarks. The smart move on these days isn't to panic-sell your holdings, but also not to add new risk by buying — patience preserves capital for better setups.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險規避」(Risk-Off) 是指投資者普遍賣出成長股等高風險資產，轉向較安全的資產，這也是為何納斯達克指數跌幅通常會比大盤指數更明顯。在這種日子，聰明的做法不是恐慌性拋售現有持倉，但也不應該貿然加碼買入新倉位——保持耐心，等待更好的進場時機才是王道。

market_education.summary_en: Broad equity indices declined today, with growth-heavy NASDAQ underperforming the more diversified S&P 500, a pattern typical of risk-off sessions where investors rotate out of higher-beta names. Without specific headline catalysts available today, the move appears consistent with general risk aversion rather than a single news event. On days like this, the prudent approach is to avoid chasing new positions and instead protect existing gains.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤普遍下跌，以科技股為主的納斯達克指數跌幅（-1.1%）大於較分散的標普500指數（-0.5%），這是典型的「風險規避」交易日特徵，投資者傾向拋售高波動性的成長股。目前沒有具體的新聞頭條可作為下跌的明確催化劑，顯示這更像是普遍性的避險情緒而非單一事件所致。在這種時候，較審慎的做法是避免追高建立新倉位，並專注於保護現有持倉的獲利。
